policy_values.pageable_blocking: default original late CPU metadata migration
policy_values.pinned_blocking: pin host metadata during prefill and migrate on current stream with blocking copy

policy_values.pinned_side_stream: pin host metadata and issue non_blocking H2D copies on per-device side streams, synchronized before decode after computation-buffer allocation
